meta.title: VibeDev Account & Models
meta.description: Sign in to VibeDev (next to the DeepSeek account) to use the VibeDev gateway's models (Claude, GPT and more) in the model picker, and let the agent generate images, videos, music and podcasts and transcribe speech; paid from your VibeDev balance.

en.accountHint: Sign in to VibeDev in Settings → VibeDev account or at the bottom of the sidebar. In the VibeDev app, the account signed in to the app is used. Everything is paid from the VibeDev balance.
en.accountIntro: Once you sign in to VibeDev, the model picker gains a "{name}" group (Claude, GPT and more), and the agent can generate images, video and music. Everything is paid from your VibeDev balance, separately from the DeepSeek account.
en.balanceFrozen: On hold: {amount}, settled when the tasks end
en.balanceUnknown: The balance could not be read right now
en.cardFrozenNote: Held when a video task starts, settled when it ends
en.cardLatencyNote: Round trip to the VibeDev gateway, not model speed
en.cardReadFailed: Could not read it; this is the balance from {ago}
en.cardReadFailedNone: The balance could not be read
en.cardReadFailedNow: Could not read it; this is the balance read moments ago
en.confirmSpendingHint: When on, you are asked to confirm before an image, video, song or podcast is generated, with the model and the estimated price. Off by default.
en.feedbackAttach: Attach recent error messages (may include file paths or code snippets)
en.feedbackAttachEmpty: No recent errors; nothing will be attached.
en.feedbackAttachFailed: Could not read the error messages; nothing will be attached.
en.feedbackErrorFailed: Could not send it. Check your connection and try again.
en.feedbackErrorInvalid: The feedback was not accepted as written. Edit it and try again.
en.feedbackErrorRejected: VibeDev did not accept this feedback ({code}).
en.feedbackIntro: Tell us what works and what needs improving. Feedback is sent to the VibeDev team with your VibeDev account.
en.feedbackPlaceholder: What went wrong, or what would you like to see?
en.feedbackQueuedLater: Saved; it will be sent automatically later
en.feedbackQueuedOffline: Saved; it will be sent automatically once you are online
en.feedbackQueuedSignedOut: Saved; it will be sent once you sign in to VibeDev
en.feedbackSignedOut: Feedback is sent with your VibeDev account, never anonymously. Sign in to VibeDev first.
en.hostHint: The VibeDev app manages this account; sign out from the account menu at the bottom of the app's sidebar.
en.hostStatus: Signed in through the VibeDev app{who}
en.keyStatus: Using a development key from the environment
en.loadFailed: The VibeDev account could not be read. Try again later.
en.modelsHint: A model ID entered here is used first; leave it empty to let the agent choose from the VibeDev catalog. Ask the agent to list the media models to see what is available and what it costs.
en.modelsHost: The VibeDev app already lists these models itself
en.outputDirHint: Relative to the workspace. Images, videos, audio and transcripts go into its images, videos, audio and transcripts folders. Clear it to go back to media.
en.pendingLink: Browser did not open? Open the sign-in page
en.pendingStatus: The VibeDev sign-in page is open in your browser; this updates once you finish there.
en.register: Register or top up at VibeDev
en.saveFailed: The settings were not saved. Try again.
en.sidebarIntro: Sign in to use the VibeDev models and media generation

en.signInNetwork: Could not connect to the sign-in service. Check your network and try signing in again.

en.signInTimeout: The sign-in service did not respond in time. Please sign in again.
en.signInUnavailable: The sign-in service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
en.signInUnknown: Could not complete sign-in. Please sign in again.
en.signOutFailed: Signing out did not work. Try again.
en.unavailable: The plugin is not running, so its settings cannot be changed right now.
